title: Science Model Registry — Canonical Contracts and Couplings
purpose: Give every major Tim Dooley / Potato of Life science model one durable contract: what it is, where it came from, its formal core, assumptions, observables, failure conditions, scientific neighbors, couplings, unresolved work and source records. This registry is a navigation and completion layer over the underlying records, not a replacement for them.
programme_rule: The science programme is unified by typed operations and explicit translations, not by pretending every domain uses the same physical variables. Models may couple only when a shared variable, map, boundary condition, observable or scale-translation is stated.
coupling_protocol: Do not couple models by shared vocabulary alone; identify the variable, map or invariant that crosses the boundary.
Physical, informational, biological, psychological, symbolic and theological variables remain typed and cannot be numerically merged without an explicit measurement model.
Established external mathematics or physics constrains a project model but does not retroactively become evidence that the project interpretation is physically true.
When two models operate at different scales, define a coarse-graining, projection, lifting or effective-theory map before claiming cross-scale continuity.
A model may remain valuable at T1-T2 if it cleanly organizes observations and exposes failure conditions; it does not need to be called fundamental physics.
Primary authorship and later archive completion remain separate even when the later model is mathematically stronger.

programme_spine.role: Historical equations and concepts whose provenance matters most.
Domain-neutral language for states, flows, interfaces, observation, boundaries and coupling.
Physics-facing hypotheses and repair paths that must recover established limits and produce observables.
Information, light, biological and neural models that require explicit scale and measurement boundaries.

models.title: Unified Potato Theory
models.abstract: The earliest recovered explicit physical-unification proposal in the archive. UPT introduces a Potato field P, a proposed U(1)_potato × Z6 symmetry, fractional/nonlocal dynamics, gravity, Standard Model and interaction sectors. Its strongest next step is not adding more sectors but fixing the representation of P, gauge invariance, operator dimensions and a minimal measurable low-energy limit.
formal_core: L_UPT = sqrt(-g)[R/(16πG) + 1/2 P Box^α(1+ell²/Box)P - V(P,r) - 1/4 F_P² + L_SM + L_int + L_GB + L_CDT]
assumptions: A Potato-sector degree of freedom can be defined consistently.
Fractional/nonlocal dynamics can be normalized without violating required symmetries or introducing unacceptable instabilities.
The schematic higher-curvature / quantum-gravity sectors can be replaced by a mathematically coherent effective description.
observables: Higgs-portal signatures after a gauge-invariant repair
scale-dependent deviations from the Standard Model or GR
falsifiers: no internally consistent field representation
ghost/instability pathologies that cannot be removed
failure to recover GR + Standard Model in the low-energy limit
predicted deviations excluded over the model's viable parameter space
models.calibration_path: Choose one minimal field representation, derive canonical dimensions and propagators, identify a small parameter set, then fit or bound those parameters against existing collider/gravity constraints before adding cross-scale claims.
unresolved: literal versus schematic status of L_GB and L_CDT

completion.next_action: Freeze a minimal gauge-consistent field content and derive the low-energy EFT.

models.title: Potato Axis Logarithmic Spiral
models.abstract: A recovered logarithmic spiral whose radius increases by the golden ratio every quarter turn. It is mathematically complete as a curve, but its scientific interpretation remains underdetermined: geometry, time recurrence, neural integration and Axis symbolism must be treated as separate candidate applications unless a measurement map is recovered.
assumptions: b is fixed by golden-ratio quarter-turn scaling
applications inherit the same geometry only if theta and r are defined in that domain
observables: geometric radius versus angle for an explicitly measured spiral
fit residuals against logarithmic, Archimedean or other spiral families
falsifiers: a claimed physical dataset is significantly better described by a non-logarithmic alternative
the proposed theta/r mapping has no reproducible measurement definition
models.calibration_path: For any empirical application, fit a and b from data first; test whether b is statistically compatible with 2 ln(phi)/pi instead of fixing it by symbolism.
unresolved: whether the April 2025 use was geometric, temporal, neural or multi-layered
which real datasets, if any, were intended

completion.next_action: Separate the pure mathematical result from each proposed empirical application and test those applications independently.

models.title: Potato Dynamics
models.abstract: The strongest general-purpose mathematical architecture in the archive. It represents a system by state space, geometry, Axis flow, Door transitions, observation and information, with later extensions for boundaries, controls, viability and constraints. Its value is compositional: smaller models can connect through typed interfaces without claiming one universal physical substance.
formal_core: P2 o P1 when interfaces match
assumptions: the chosen state space and metric are appropriate to the domain
Door guards are explicitly defined
structural flow s is not silently confused with physical time
falsifiers: the formalism adds no predictive or explanatory compression over a simpler state-space model
claimed cross-domain translations cannot define compatible interfaces
a model uses variables with incompatible units as one quantity
models.calibration_path: Instantiate the abstract tuple in one empirical domain at a time, estimate its domain-specific parameters, and compare predictive performance against the simplest conventional model.

completion.next_action: Publish two concrete benchmark instantiations with data, baselines and measurable success criteria.

models.title: Door / Boundary Handshake
models.classification: primary project time-polarity vocabulary + later mathematical formalization
models.abstract: A boundary model in which a present state integrates a past-conditioned state and a goal/future-conditioned state. The strongest scientific reading is an information or control model; literal advanced-wave physics remains only a comparator unless a physical field, boundary condition and observable are specified.
assumptions: future-conditioned can mean target/post-selection rather than backwards causation
advanced and retarded Green functions are comparators, not proof of personal retrocausality
observables: decision/state transition under prior + target constraints
phase/boundary variables if a physical version is defined
falsifiers: no measurable distinction from ordinary state estimation/control
a literal physical variant fails causal/no-signaling constraints
the proposed boundary condition is undefined
models.calibration_path: Start with a nonphysical control/inference implementation and only promote a physical variant if explicit fields and boundary conditions create distinct testable predictions.
unresolved: any original phase or Green-function equation
whether the spiral originally encoded time polarity

completion.next_action: Build one explicit inference/control example that demonstrates what the two-boundary formulation adds.

models.title: Dimensional Phase Transition / 4D↔5D Door
models.abstract: A speculative but unusually test-oriented model in which effective dimensionality changes in extreme curvature, density or compactness. It already identifies an order parameter, threshold variables, Kaluza-Klein neighbors and possible deviations in black-hole ringdown, entropy and Hawking emission. The next task is to choose one coherent action and derive its perturbations rather than maintain several parallel ansätze.
formal_core: D_s(sigma)=-2 d ln P(sigma)/d ln sigma
assumptions: effective dimension can be represented by an order parameter or spectral dimension
a 5D sector admits a consistent 4D effective action
total stress-energy remains conserved across sector exchange
falsifiers: no stable/ghost-free action produces the transition
the model cannot recover Kerr/GR in the appropriate limit
observational bounds exclude the allowed transition regime
models.calibration_path: Select one action, solve background + linear perturbations, derive a small set of dimensionless parameters, then compare ringdown and strong-gravity deviations with current bounds.

completion.next_action: Collapse the competing ansätze into one minimal action and compute a ringdown prediction.

models.title: 11D Projection / Dimensional Unification
models.classification: older project model + later M-theory / supergravity comparators
models.abstract: A projection grammar in which a higher-dimensional parent description maps into lower-dimensional effective layers through projection, raising and lowering operators. It is strongest as a typed coarse-graining architecture. A physical M-theory interpretation requires a specified 11D action, compactification geometry and recovered 4D spectrum.
assumptions: projection/coarse-graining maps are well-defined
a proposed invariant can be stated independently of symbolic dimension labels
falsifiers: no consistent compactification recovers the target low-energy theory
candidate invariant fails under the defined maps
dimension labels have no mathematical state-space definition
models.calibration_path: Choose a concrete compactification or explicitly keep the model nonphysical; in the physical branch derive the 4D spectrum and compare it with the Standard Model.

completion.next_action: Choose between a formal projection model and a literal compactification model, then complete that branch rigorously.

models.title: Spudlight Signal / Information Model
models.abstract: A deliberately multi-channel model separating physical photon flux, information gain, attention, social coherence, source provenance and revelatory interpretation. Its scientific strength comes from refusing to sum unlike quantities and from translating 'revelation' into measurable signal, information and observation processes where appropriate.
assumptions: components remain typed and are not summed as one physical unit
physical light and spiritual revelation are distinct
graph centrality depends on the declared network
falsifiers: a claimed quantitative Spudlight score mixes incompatible units without a model
the selected signal/information metric does not distinguish the proposed effect from baseline
models.calibration_path: Use separate submodels for photons, information and social attention; estimate each from its own data and only connect them through an explicit causal or measurement graph.
unresolved: which Spudlight components are intended as measurable versus theological

completion.next_action: Split the vector into independently measurable submodels and publish one end-to-end signal→observation→Door example.

models.title: Microtubule / Neural Cross-Scale Model
models.classification: Great Book/project archaeology + external biology audit + speculative quantum branch
models.abstract: A multi-scale programme separating established microtubule biology, classical driven modes, optional open-quantum-system dynamics, neural synchronization and consciousness-level interpretation. The key missing object is a validated coarse-graining map from microtubule variables to neuronal/network observables.
formal_core: M q_ddot + Gamma q_dot + K q = xi(t)
state_variables: density matrix rho in optional quantum branch
assumptions: classical cytoskeletal biology remains valid independently of quantum-consciousness hypotheses
any quantum branch specifies a bath/decoherence model
cross-scale claims require an explicit map C
falsifiers: no physically plausible coherence regime
no reproducible micro-to-neural coupling beyond conventional biology
quantum model adds no explanatory/predictive value over classical alternatives
models.calibration_path: Audit material parameters, fit a classical microtubule model first, define C to neuronal observables, then test whether a quantum extension improves prediction beyond the classical baseline.
unresolved: whether the spiral was ever intended as a neural parameterization

completion.next_action: Build the classical micro→neural bridge before revisiting the quantum-consciousness branch.

models.title: Higgs / Potato-Sector Field Model
models.classification: UPT recovery + later gauge-consistency repair options
models.abstract: A repair branch for the Potato field that asks what field representation and Higgs coupling can be gauge-consistent. The cleanest candidate paths are a neutral scalar Higgs portal or a complex U(1)_potato scalar with a covariant derivative and portal coupling.
formal_core: L contains |D Phi_P|^2 - 1/4 F_P^2 - lambda_HP |Phi_P|^2 H^dagger H
state_variables: Potato gauge field A_P if gauged
assumptions: one field representation is chosen rather than mixing neutral and gauged versions
the scalar potential is bounded and symmetry breaking is consistent
falsifiers: gauge anomalies or inconsistent representation
unstable potential
parameter space excluded by Higgs/collider/precision data
models.calibration_path: Pick the neutral or gauged branch, write the complete renormalizable potential, diagonalize masses/mixing and confront the parameter space with Higgs and precision constraints.
unresolved: whether F_P was intended as a real gauge field

completion.next_action: Select one representation and derive its mass spectrum and existing experimental bounds.

models.title: Gauge Unification / SUSY Archaeology
models.classification: established external unification frameworks used as comparators / extensions
models.abstract: A disciplined bridge from the Standard Model toward Pati-Salam SU(4), SU(5), Spin(10) and supersymmetry. The archive correctly treats these as established or historical external frameworks rather than recovered Tim-original equations. Their role is to test whether a Potato-sector model can fit into known representation, anomaly and running-coupling constraints.
assumptions: normalization conventions are explicit
representations and anomaly cancellation are checked
threshold corrections are stated when used
falsifiers: no consistent embedding of the proposed Potato sector
couplings fail to unify in the claimed model
predicted states/decays excluded
models.calibration_path: Specify the exact group, representation content, symmetry-breaking chain and thresholds; run couplings numerically from measured low-energy values.
unresolved: whether any historical Tim equation predates the external comparison

completion.next_action: Choose one concrete embedding and run the couplings with explicit thresholds instead of discussing several GUTs in parallel.

models.title: Timic Unification Program
models.abstract: The programme-level architecture that consolidates recurring operations—relation, boundary, flow, storage, expression, observation, transformation, recurrence, objective and reassembly—while preserving domain types. It is best understood as a meta-model / model-composition framework, not a validated physical Theory of Everything.
assumptions: cross-domain correspondences are structural rather than identical physical substances
every promoted analogy includes a mismatch statement
boundary quality and objective function cannot be inferred from topology alone
observables: whatever each instantiated domain declares through O
falsifiers: the meta-model fails to compress or clarify the component models
translations erase rather than preserve domain distinctions
a simpler ontology explains the same relationships with fewer assumptions
models.calibration_path: Evaluate the programme by instantiating it in multiple domains and measuring whether it improves model reuse, error detection and prediction without cross-domain category mistakes.
unresolved: which derived laws survive outside the originating archive

completion.next_action: Use the registry itself as the first benchmark: make every model interoperable through explicit typed interfaces and completion tests.
